text: The Prophet (pbuh) received him, grabbed him and shook him once or twice and then said: (Nearer unto thee and nearer) this is a threat to you, O Abu Jahl, it is indeed a threat.

arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
text: (Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom)) beware, O Abu Jahl.

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
text: The Qur'an also said: (Thinks man) the disbelieving man, i.e. Abu Jahl (that he is to be left aimless) neglected, without any commands, prohibitions or admonition?

arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
text: (Was he not) i.e. Abu Jahl (a drop of fluid) man's sperm drops (which gushed forth) in the woman's womb; and it is also said: created in the woman's womb?

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
text: (Then he became a clot) then he became clotted blood; (then (Allah) shaped) him a living being (and fashioned) him with two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears as well as with all the other members, and also placed in him the spirit.

arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلأُنثَىٰ
text: (And made of him) after that (a pair, the male and female) Abu Jahl had a son called 'Ikrimah Ibn Abi Jahl and a daughter called Juwayrah Bint Abi Jahl.

arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِـيَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
text: (Is not He (who doeth so) able to bring the dead to life) for the resurrection? Indeed, our Lord is Able to do so; He is Able to bring the dead back to life just as He did create Adam from dust'.

arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئاً مَّذْكُوراً
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Hath there come upon man (ever)): '(Hath there come upon man (ever)) there has come upon Adam (any period of time) a period of 40 years when he was created and fashioned (in which he was a thing unremembered?) not knowing who he was, what his name was or what Allah wanted from him.

arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعاً بَصِيراً
text: (Lo! We create man) i.e. the progeny of Adam (from a drop of thickened fluid) from Adam and Eve's drops of two different kinds of fluid: that of man being white and thick and that of the woman being yellow and thin; thus progeny comes from both of them (to test him) with hardship and comfort; it is also said this means: to test him with good and evil; (so We make him hearing, knowing) We gave him the faculty of hearing so that he could hear the Truth and guidance and the faculty of sight so that he could see the Truth and guidance. It is also said that We make him hearing, knowing in order to test him with good and evil, faith and disbelief.

arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِراً وَإِمَّا كَفُوراً
text: (Lo! We have shown him the way) of faith and disbelief, good and evil, (whether he be grateful) accepting faith (or disbelieving) it is also said this means: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلاَسِلاَ وَأَغْلاَلاً وَسَعِيراً
text: (Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers) Abu Jahl and his followers (manacles and carcans) in the Fire (and a raging fire.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوراً
text: Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith and obey Allah (shall drink of a cup) shall drink wine in Paradise (whereof the mixture is of water of Kafur,

arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيراً
text: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah) the friends of Allah (drink, making it gush forth abundantly) whenever they wish, from the Garden into their own habitations and palaces; it is also said that this means: they make it into a mixture;

arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْماً كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيراً
text: Allah then described their traits when they were in the life of the world, saying: (Because they perform the vow) because they fulfil their pledges and oath by Allah; it is also said this means: they perform the obligations (and fear a day) and fear the torment of a day (whereof the evil) the torment (is wide spreading,

arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِيناً وَيَتِيماً وَأَسِيراً
text: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan) among the Muslims (and the prisoner) and the Muslim prisoner in the captivity of the idolaters; and it is also said: any kind of prisoner, (for love of Him) despite their desire for food and its scarcity,

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلاَ شُكُوراً
text: ((Saying)) that is inwardly, because they did not utter this openly but Allah informed us about the genuineness of their hearts: (We feed you, for the sake of Allah only) we feed you for the sake of Allah's reward and beneficence only. (We wish for no reward) with which to pay us back (nor thanks from you) nor gratitude from you;

arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْماً عَبُوساً قَمْطَرِيراً
text: (Lo! we fear from our Lord) from the punishment of our Lord (a day of frowning) when faces are frowning (and of fate) a hard day whose torment and horrors are severe.

arabic: فَوَقَٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَومِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُوراً
text: (Therefore Allah hath warded from them the evil of that day) the torment of that day, (and hath made them find) and has given them (brightness) bright and beautiful faces (and joy) in their hearts;

arabic: وَجَزَاهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيراً
text: (And hath awarded them for all that they endured) in the life of the world of poverty and misfortunes, (a Garden and silk attire;

arabic: مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَىٰ ٱلأَرَائِكِ لاَ يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْساً وَلاَ زَمْهَرِيراً
text: (Reclining therein) sitting comfortably in the Garden (upon couches) in curtained canopies, (they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold) He says: they are touched neither by the heat of the sun nor by cold.

arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلاَلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلاً
text: (The shade) of trees (thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down) are made close and available to them.

arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَاْ
text: (Goblets of silver are brought round for them) by servants, (and beakers (as) of glass) without handles or covers

arabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيراً
text: ((Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured) in the hands of slave youths (to the measure (of their deeds)) it is also said that the drink is so measured that it is neither more nor less than what is required.

arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْساً كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلاً
text: (There) in the Garden (are they watered with a cup) of wine (whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

arabic: عَيْناً فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلاً
text: The water of a spring therein) in the Garden, (named Salsabil.

arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤاً مَّنثُوراً
text: There wait on them youths of immortal youths) in Paradise who never die or are taken out of it; it is also said this means: youths wearing beautiful garments, (whom, when you see) O Muhammad, (thou wouldst take for scattered pearls) because of their brightness; and it is also said this means: because of their scatteredness.

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيماً وَمُلْكاً كَبِيراً
text: (When thou seest) O Muhammad, (thou wilt see there) in the Garden (bliss) lasting bliss for its dwellers (and high estate) none enters in on them except with greetings of peace and permission.

arabic: عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوۤاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَاباً طَهُوراً
text: (Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink) pure from filth; it is also said this means: Allah purifies them from hatred, cheating and enmity.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُوراً
text: (Lo! This) which I have described to you of food, drink and raiment (is a reward for you) is a reward from Allah. (Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance) your works were accepted and made to grow.

arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلاً
text: (Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an) We have sent you Gabriel with the Qur'an, (a revelation) in instalments: one, two and three verses at a time;

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلاَ تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِماً أَوْ كَفُوراً
text: (So submit patiently to thy Lord's command) to your Lord's decree; and it is also said this means: be patient in conveying the message of your Lord, (and obey not of them) of the disbelievers of Quraysh (any guilty one) any lewd and liar one, i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (or disbeliever) in Allah, i.e. 'Utbah Ibn Rabi'ah.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
text: (Remember the name of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord (at morn and evening) i.e. the prayers of Fajr, Zuhr and 'Asr.

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلاً طَوِيلاً
text: (And worship Him (a portion) of the night) pray the prayer of Maghrib and 'Isha'. (And glorify Him through the livelong night) pray to Him at night, this refers to supererogatory prayers; it is also said that the night prayer was made compulsory on him but not on his Companions.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْماً ثَقِيلاً
text: (Lo! These) the people of Mecca (love fleeting life) love striving for the life of the world, (and put behind them (the remembrance of)) and refrain from striving for the day which is ahead of them (a grievous day) whose torment and horrors are severe.

arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلاً
text: (We, even We, created them) i.e. the people of Mecca, (and strengthened their frame) and made their constitution strong. (And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them) i.e. We destroy them (in their stead) He says: if We had willed, We would have destroyed these sinful and disbelieving people and brought instead of them people who are better and more obedient.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاً
text: (Lo! this is an Admonishment) from Allah, (that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord) that whoever will may believe in Allah's divine Oneness and return to his Lord.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً
text: (Yet ye will not) good or evil, faith or disbelief, (unless Allah willeth) that you will it. (Lo! Allah is Knower) of what you will whether it is good or evil, (Wise) He decreed that you do not will anything of good or evil except that which He wills.

arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَٱلظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً
text: (He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy) He honours whoever deserves it with the religion of Islam, (and for evil-doers) the disbelieving idolaters (hath prepared) soon in the Hereafter (a painful doom) whose pain extends to their hearts'.

arabic: وَٱلْمُرْسَلاَتِ عُرْفاً
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the emissaries, (sent) one after another): '(By the emissaries, (sent) one after another) He says: Allah swears by the many angels who are sent one after another, just like horses follow one another; it is also said that these are the angels who are sent with the good, i.e. Gabriel, Michael and Seraphiel.

arabic: فَٱلْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفاً
text: (By the raging hurricanes) and He swore by the violent hurricanes which blow away people's houses,

arabic: وٱلنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْراً
text: (By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive) and He swore by the rain, i.e. He swore by the clouds from which comes the rain; it is also said: this refers to the angels who spread the Scripture;

arabic: فَٱلْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقاً
text: (By those who winnow with a winnowing) and He swore by the angels who differentiate between the Truth and falsehood; it is also said that this refers to the verses of the Qur'an which distinguishes the Truth from falsehood, the lawful from the unlawful; and it is also said that these three refer to the angels,

arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْراً
text: (By those who bring down the Reminder) and He swore by those who bring down the revelations,

arabic: عُذْراً أَوْ نُذْراً
text: (To excuse) to leave no excuse for one to think that Allah is an oppressor or transgressor (or to warn) His created beings from His chastisement; it is also said that (to excuse) refers to that which He has made lawful while (or to warn) refers to that which He has made unlawful; and it is also said (to excuse) refers to His commands while (or to warn) refers to His prohibitions; Allah swore by all these things,

arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
text: (Surely that which ye are promised) of reward and punishment in the Hereafter (will befall) will happen and visit you.

arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
text: Allah then showed when this will be, saying: (So when the stars are put out) when the light of the stars is gone,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
text: (And when the sky is riven asunder,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
text: And when the mountains are blown away,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
text: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed) and when the messengers are gathered.

arabic: لأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
text: (For what day is the time appointed) for these things? He says: for what day has its Master delayed it.

arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
text: Allah then explained, saying: (For the Day of Decision) when differences between people will be settled.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
text: (And what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Decision is!) How would you know about the Day of Decision?

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) a valley in Gehenna running with blood and puss; and it is also said: a well in the Fire; and it is also said that this refers to severe punishment (unto the repudiators) the disbelievers in Allah, the Scripture, the Messenger and resurrection after death (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
text: (Destroyed We not the former folk) by means of death as well as chastisement,

arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلآخِرِينَ
text: (Then caused the latter folk to follow after) through death and chastisement?

arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
text: (Thus deal We ever with the guilty) with the idolaters among your folk.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) to the deniers of resurrection after death from among the people of your folk (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
text: (Did We not create you) O disbelievers (from a base fluid) from a flimsy sperm drop

arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
text: (Which We laid up in a safe abode) in the woman's womb.

arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
text: (For a known term) until the time of its birth after nine months or less or more?

arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَادِرُونَ
text: (Thus We arranged) its creation; it is also said this means: We controlled its creation; it is also said this means: and We fashioned its creation in the woman's womb. (How excellent is Our arranging!) how excellent is what We created and fashioned!

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and resurrection after death (on that day) on the Day of Judgement!

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلأَرْضَ كِفَاتاً
text: (Have We not made the earth a receptacle) to contain them

arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوٰتاً
text: (Both for the living) on its surface (and the dead) in its belly; it is also said this means: We made the earth a channel for both the living and the dead,

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتاً
text: (And placed therein) in the earth (high mountains) firm mountains well-steeped in their locations (and given you) O repudiators (to drink sweet water therein) and it is said fine water?

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
text: (Depart) O repudiators (unto that (doom) which ye used to deny) in the life of the world, claiming that it will never take place;

arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلاَثِ شُعَبٍ
text: The angels who are the keepers of the Fire will say to them after the end of reckoning: (Depart) O deniers (unto the shadow) caused by the smoke of the Fire (falling threefold) three groups.

arabic: لاَّ ظَلِيلٍ وَلاَ يُغْنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
text: ((Which yet is) no relief) from the heat of the Fire (nor shelter from the flame) of the Fire.

arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
text: (Lo! It) i.e. the Fire (throweth up sparks like the castles) like the bases of huge trees,

arabic: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
text: ((Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue) black camels.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لاَ يَنطِقُونَ
text: (This is a day wherein they speak not) in some places and speak in others,

arabic: وَلاَ يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
text: (Nor are they suffered) nor are they given permission (to put forth excuses.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلأَوَّلِينَ
text: (This is the Day of Decision) regarding created beings, (We have brought you) O disbelievers (and the men of old together) as well as those who were after you.

arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكمُ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
text: (If now ye have any wit) if you have the power to do anything to Me, (outwit Me) then do it; it is also said that this means: if you have any scheme against Me, then execute it.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلاَلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
text: Allah then explained the abode of the believers, saying: (Lo! those who kept their duty) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (are amid shade) amid the shade of trees (and fountains) plain, running water,

arabic: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
text: (And fruits) different kinds of fruit (such as they desire).

arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيـۤئاً بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text: Allah will say to them (Eat) of the fruits, (drink) from the rivers (and welcome) fearing no sickness or death, (O ye blessed, in return for what ye did) and said of good in the life of the world.

arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
text: (Thus do We reward the good) in words and deeds.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ مُّجْرِمُونَ
text: (Eat) O disbelievers (and take your ease a little) in the life of the world. (Lo! ye are guilty) you are idolaters and your destination in the Hereafter will be the Fire. This is a threat to them from Allah.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: وَإذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُواْ لاَ يَرْكَعُونَ
text: (When it is said unto them) to the disbelievers when they were in the life of the world: (Bow down) submit to Allah by believing in His divine Oneness, (they bow not down!) they did not submit to Allah by accepting His divine Oneness; it is also said that they will be asked to do so in the Hereafter, when Allah will say to them: " bow down, if you are truthful that you believed in that which you now claim " , this is because they said: " By Allah, our Lord, we were not idolaters ". But they will not be able to bow down and their bodies will remain erect and stiff. It is also said that this verse was revealed about Thaqif who said: " we will not bend down to bow or prostrate ".

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) to the disbelievers in Allah, His Messenger, Scripture and the resurrection (on that day) the day of Judgement!

arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ
text: (In what statement) in what Scripture, (after this) after the Book of Allah, (will they believe) if they do not believe in these tidings?'

arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Whereof do they question one another?): He says: 'what are they-meaning the people of Quraysh-talking about?'

arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text: ((It is) of the awful tidings) they are talking about the tidings of the noble, glorious and great Qur'an,

arabic: ٱلَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
text: (Concerning which they are in disagreement) some of them disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an while others believe in them. This is because whenever Gabriel brought down a section of the Qur'an to the Prophet (pbuh) and he recited it to them, they used to talk about it, and some of them would believe while others would persist in their disbelief.

arabic: كَلاَّ سَيَعْلَمُونَ
text: (Nay) this is a reply to the disbelievers, (but they will come to know!) They will come to know upon the advent of death what will be done with them.

arabic: ثُمَّ كَلاَّ سَيَعْلَمُونَ
text: (Nay) truly, (again, but they will come to know!) They will come to know in the grave what will be done with them. This is a threat from Allah to those who disbelieved in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an.

arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلأَرْضَ مِهَٰداً
text: Allah then mentioned the blessings He bestowed upon them, saying: (Have We not made the earth an expanse) and a place to sleep,

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَاداً
text: (And the high hills bulwarks) for it so that it does not sway?

arabic: وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجاً
text: (And We have created you in pairs) male and female,

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتاً
text: (And have appointed your sleep for repose) a repose for your bodies; and it is said this means: nice and beautiful,

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيلَ لِبَاساً
text: (And have appointed the night as a cloak) and it is said this means: a dwelling,

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشاً
text: (And have appointed the day for livelihood) for seeking livelihood.

arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعاً شِدَاداً
text: (And We have built) and We have created (above you) above your heads (seven strong (heavens)) seven thick heavens,

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً
text: (And have appointed a dazzling lamp) and have appointed a radiant sun for the children of Adam,

arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجاً
text: (And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant Water,

arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبّاً وَنَبَاتاً
text: Thereby to produce grain and plant) to produce through the rain all kinds of grains and plants,

arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافاً
text: (And gardens of thick foliage) and it is also said this means: different kinds of foliage.

arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتاً
text: (Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time) it is the appointed time when the people of old and later generations will be gathered,

arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجاً
text: (A day when the trumpet is blown) the blowing of the resurrection, (and ye come in multitudes) host after host and group after group,

arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَاباً
text: (And the heaven is opened) and the gates of heaven are opened (and becometh as gates) and becomes different roads,

arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَاباً
text: (And the hills are set in motion) on the face of the earth (and become as a mirage.

arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَاداً
text: Lo! Hell lurketh in ambush) the Fire is a detention and prison,

arabic: لِّلطَّاغِينَ مَآباً
text: (A home for the rebellious) a point of return for the disbelievers.

arabic: لاَّبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَاباً
text: (They will abide therein for ages) they will abide in the Fire for ages and ages, each age consisting of 80 years, each year being 360 days and each day is the equivalent of 1,000 years of the years of the life of the world; it is also said that none knows the exact duration of these ages save Allah, and therefore these ages are never interrupted.

arabic: لاَّ يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْداً وَلاَ شَرَاباً
text: (Therein) in the Fire (taste they neither coolness) cool water; and it is also said this means: sleep (nor (any) drink) cold drink

arabic: إِلاَّ حَمِيماً وَغَسَّاقاً
text: (Save boiling water and a paralysing cold) and it is also said this means: filthy water:

arabic: جَزَآءً وِفَاقاً
text: (Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds)) a reward which is commensurate with their works.

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ لاَ يَرْجُونَ حِسَاباً
text: (For lo! they looked not) while in the life of the world (for a reckoning) they did not fear the chastisement of the Hereafter nor did they believe in it;

arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّاباً
text: (They called Our revelations) Our Scripture and Messenger (false with strong denial.

arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَاباً
text: Everything) regarding the works of the children of Adam (have We recorded in a Book) We wrote it down in the Guarded or Preserved Tablet.

arabic: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلاَّ عَذَاباً
text: (So taste) the chastisement in the Fire. (No increase do We give you) in the Fire (save of torment) one kind of torment after another.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازاً
text: (Lo! for the duteous) for those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (is achievement) safety from the Fire and nearness of Allah

arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَاباً
text: (Gardens) of trees and palm-trees (enclosed and vineyards,

arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَاباً
text: And maidens for companions) who are all of the same age: 33 years of age,

arabic: وَكَأْساً دِهَاقاً
text: (And a full cup) one cup after another.

arabic: لاَّ يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواً وَلاَ كِذَّاباً
text: (There) in Paradise (hear they) the inhabitants of the Garden (never vain discourse) oaths or falsehood, (nor lying) they do not lie to each other.

arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَاباً
text: (Requital) a reward (from thy Lord a gift) that He bestows upon them in the Garden (in payment) ten rewards for each good deed; and it is also said this means: reward in proportion to their good deeds

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لاَ يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَاباً
text: (Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them) of creation and marvels, (the Beneficent) He is the Beneficent; (with Whom none) none of His slaves, i.e. the angels as well as others (can converse) with regard to intercession until Allah gives them permission to do so.

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ صَفّاً لاَّ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلاَّ مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَاباً
text: (On the day when the angels and the Spirit) Gabriel; and it is also said: this is a created being whose tremendousness only Allah knows; Ibn Mas'ud also said: the Spirit is an angel greater than every thing save the Throne, and this angel glorifies Allah each day 12,000 formulas of glorification, and which each glorification he utters Allah creates an angel who seeks forgiveness for the believers until the Day of Judgement; it is also said this refers to a group of angels who have feet and hands like those of humans (stand arrayed, they speak not) to intercede, (saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth) to intercede (and who speaketh right) truly “there is no deity save Allah”.

arabic: ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآباً
text: (That is the True Day) in which will happen what I have mentioned. (So whoso will should seek recourse) whoever will believe in Allah's divine Oneness and seek through his belief in Allah's divine Oneness a way of return (unto his Lord.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَاباً قَرِيباً يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَاباً
text: Lo! We warn you) O people of Mecca (of a doom at hand) which will surely happen, (a day whereon a man will look) when the believer will look; and it is also said: when the disbeliever will look (on that which his own hands have sent before) have earned of good or evil, (and the disbeliever will cry: “Would that I were dust!”) with the beasts. Because of the horrors, severity and torment of that day, the disbeliever will wish to be turned into dust along with beasts. This will occur on the day when the first trumpet resounds'.

arabic: وَٱلنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقاً
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By those who drag forth): '(By those who drag forth) He says: Allah swears by the angels who take away the souls of the disbelievers (to destruction) the souls of the disbelievers,

arabic: وَٱلنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطاً
text: (By the meteors rushing) and it is also said that He is here swearing by the angels who busy the disbelievers with grief and anxiety; it is also said that this refers to the souls of the believers which hasten to come out of their bodies in order to go to the Garden.

arabic: وَٱلسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحاً
text: (By the lone stars floating) and it is also said that He is here swearing by the angels who take away the souls of the righteous slowly and gently and then let them rest; it is also said this refers to the souls of the believers,

arabic: فَٱلسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقاً
text: (By the angels hastening) and He swears by the angels who hasten to Paradise with the souls of the believers and to the Fire with the souls of the disbelievers; it is also said this refers to the souls of the believers that hasten to Paradise,

arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْراً
text: (And those who govern the event) and He swears by the angels who govern the matters of the slaves, meaning Gabriel, Michael, Seraphiel and the angel of death. It is said that (those who govern the event) refers to the spears of soldiers, (the meteors rushing) refers to the ropes of soldiers and (the lone stars floating) refers to the ships of soldiers who fight at sea, (the ones who do the hastening) refers to the horses of soldiers, while (those who govern the event) refers to the generals of soldiers; it is also said that (the lone stars floating) refer to the sun, the moon, the day and the night. Allah swore by all these that the two blowings of the trumpet will take place, with an interval of 40 years separating the two blowings.

arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
text: So Allah said: (On the day when the first trump resoundeth) this refers to the first blowing of the trumpet when everything will quake.

arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
text: (And the second followeth it) this is the final blowing on the trumpet,

arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
text: (On that day) which is the Day of Judgement (hearts beat painfully) the hearts are fearful

arabic: أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ
text: (While eyes are downcast) abased

arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
text: ((Now) they) the disbelievers of Mecca: al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and his host (are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state) to the life of the world; and it is also said: from the graves

arabic: أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَاماً نَّخِرَةً
text: (Even after we are crumbled bones?) Will Allah resurrect us? How is this possible?

arabic: قَالُواْ تِلْكَ إِذاً كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
text: The Prophet (pbuh) said to them: “Indeed, Allah will raise you again from the dead”. (They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding) that would be a failed attempt, because it will never happen.

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
text: And so Allah said: (Surely it will need but one shout) one blow which does not require a second one, and this is the blow of the resurrection,

arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
text: (And lo! they will be awakened) on the face of the earth; and it is also said: in the land of the gathering.

arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ
text: (Hath there come unto thee) O Muhammad (the history of Moses) the story of Moses? Meaning: the story of Moses has already come to you; and it is also said this means: the story of Moses has not yet come to you.

arabic: إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
text: (How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa) the name of the valley; it was called so because it was traversed by so many prophets; it is also said: tread (Ta'), O Moses, with your feet on this valley because of its goodness and grace.

arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ
text: ((Saying:) Go thou) O Moses (unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath rebelled) he is arrogant and too proud and has refused to believe in Allah

arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
text: (And say (unto him): Hast thou) O Pharaoh ((will) to grow (in grace)) will become righteous, surrender and believe in Allah's divine Oneness?

arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
text: (Then I will guide thee) I will call you (to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him)) and therefore surrender to Him.

arabic: فَأَرَاهُ ٱلآيَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
text: (And he) Moses (showed him the tremendous token) the hand and the staff.

arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
text: (But be denied) and said: this is not from Allah (and disobeyed) he refused the message,

arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
text: (Then turned he away) from faith; and it is also said: from Moses (in haste) to his folk; and it is also said: to think what to do about Moses,

arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
text: (Then gathered he) his army (and summoned) and delivered a sermon

arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَاْ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
text: (And proclaimed: “I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest”.) I am your Highest Lord and the Lord of your idols, therefore, do not leave the worship of these idols.

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلآخِرَةِ وَٱلأُوْلَىٰ
text: (So Allah seized him) Allah punished him ((and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former) the punishment that he suffered in the life of the world is drowning and the punishment of the Hereafter will be in the Fire; it is also said that this means: Allah has punished him because of his former and latter pronouncements. His first pronouncement being: “I do not know of any other god for you except Me” and the second being (I am your Lord the Highest) and it is said that there is an interval of 40 years between the first and second pronouncements.

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
text: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to Pharaoh and his host (is indeed a lesson) an admonition (for him who feareth) that which has been done to them.

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقاً أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بَنَاهَا
text: (Are ye) O people of Mecca (the harder to create) harder to resurrect and more perfect in your creation, (or is the heaven that He built?

arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا
text: He raised the height) its ceiling (thereof and ordered it) above the earth;

arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا
text: (And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof) and He made its day and sun clear.

arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ دَحَاهَا
text: (And after that He spread the earth) even then He spread it on the water; it is also said: 2,000 years after that He spread it on the water,

arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا
text: (And produced therefrom) from the earth (the water thereof) running water as well as the water buried deep in the belly of the earth (and the pasture thereof,

arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا
text: And He made fast the hills) and He made the mountains firm,

arabic: مَتَاعاً لَّكُمْ وَلأَنْعَامِكُمْ
text: (A provision for you) water of benefit to you (and for your cattle) water and pasture benefit your cattle.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
text: (But when the great disaster cometh) but when the Hour comes, it will tower above everything and nothing will escape it,

arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلإِنسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ
text: (The day when man will call to mind) when the disbeliever, al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and his host, will remember and know (his (whole) endeavour) the works he did in his state of disbelief,

arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
text: (And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth) to him who is ordained to enter it,

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
text: (Then, as for him who rebelled) him who was too arrogant and proud and disbelieved in Allah, i.e. al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith Ibn 'Alqamah

arabic: وَآثَرَ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
text: (And chose the life of the world) rather than the Hereafter and also chose disbelief rather than faith,

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
text: (Lo! Hell will be his home) the Fire is the home of him who is thus.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
text: (But as for him who feared) upon committing a sin (to stand before his Lord) his standing before his Lord and abstains from engaging in sin (and restrained his soul from lust) from that which is unlawful, even though he desires it, this refers to Mus'ab Ibn 'Umayr.

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
text: (Lo! the Garden will be his home) Paradise will be the home of him who is thus.

arabic: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَٰهَا
text: (They ask thee) the disbelievers of Mecca ask you, O Muhammad, (of the Hour) about the advent of the Hour: (when will it come to port?) When is it going to happen? Because they disbelieved in it.

arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَٰهَا
text: (Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?) What has it to do with you that you should mention it to them?

arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَٰهَآ
text: (Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof) the knowledge of its timing belongs to Allah.

arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَٰهَا
text: (Thou art but a warner) you are but a warning messenger by means of the Qur'an (unto him who feareth it) to him who fears its advent.

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوۤاْ إِلاَّ عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَٰهَا
text: (On the day when they behold it) i.e. the Hour, (it will be as if they had but tarried) in the graves (for an evening) the duration of an evening (or the morn thereof) or the duration of one morning'.

arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (He frowned): '(He frowned) He says: Muhammad (pbuh) showed a stern face (and turned away) his face

arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلأَعْمَىٰ
text: (Because the blind man came unto him) when 'Abdullah Ibn Umm Maktum came to him. His real name is 'Abdullah Ibn Shurayh. Umm Maktum was his father's mother. What happened is that the Prophet (pbuh) was sitting with a group of men among the nobles of Quraysh, among whom were his uncle al-'Abbas Ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib, Umayyah Ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi and Safwan Ibn Umayyah, who were at that time disbelievers. The Prophet (pbuh) was admonishing and inviting them to Islam when Ibn Maktum came to him and said: “O Messenger of Allah! Teach me of that which Allah has taught you”. The Prophet (pbuh) turned his face from him because he was busy with these people. When this happened Allah revealed: he frowned and turned away because the blind man came unto him.

arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ
text: (What could inform thee) O Muhammad (but that he might) i.e. the blind man (grow (in grace)) became righteous through the admonitions of the Qur'an

arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
text: (Or take heed) by means of the Qur'an (and so the reminder) by means of the Qur'an (might avail him?) It is also said that this means: how do you know O Muhammad, whether or not he becomes righteous and whether or not he benefits from the admonitions of the Qur'an.

arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
text: (As for him who thinketh himself independent) of Allah, i.e. the three men mentioned above,

arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ
text: (Unto him thou payest regard) you turn your face to them.

arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلاَّ يَزَّكَّىٰ
text: (Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)) it is not your concern if these three men do not believe in Allah's divine Oneness.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
text: (But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose) hastening for goodness

arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
text: (And hath fear) of Allah, and is also a Muslim; this is because Ibn Umm Maktum had accepted Islam before this incident,

arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
text: (From him thou) O Muhammad (art distracted) being busy with those three men.

arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
text: (Nay) do not do this; He says: do not turn to those who think themselves independent of Allah and turn away from he who fears Allah. After this reminder, the Prophet (pbuh) used to honour Ibn Umm Maktum and treat him well, (but verily it) this surah (is an Admonishment) from Allah both for the rich and the poor,

arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ
text: (So let whosoever will pay heed to it) whoever Allah wants him to be admonished will be admonished,

arabic: فَي صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
text: (On honoured leaves) He says: the Qur'an is written on scrolls made of skin which are honoured in the sight of Allah

arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍ
text: (Exalted) in heaven, (purified) from filth and idolatry,

arabic: بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ
text: ((Set down) by scribes) written by scribes

arabic: كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ
text: (Noble) in the sight of Allah and surrendered to Him (and righteous) truthful; these are the keepers of the nether heaven.

arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلإِنسَانُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُ
text: (Man is (self)-destroyed) the disbeliever, i.e. 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab, is cursed: (how ungrateful!) what has made him a disbelieve in Allah and in the stars of the Qur'an, i.e. in the star when it sets; it is also said that this means: how extreme is his disbelief.

arabic: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيءٍ خَلَقَهُ
text: (From what thing doth He create him?) He says: let him think about his own person: from what did He create him as a living being?

arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ
text: Allah then explained and said to him: (From a drop of seed. He createth him) a living being (and proportioneth him) He proportioned his creation by giving him two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears as well as all the other organs,

arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ
text: (Then maketh the way easy for him) He made clear to him the way of good and the way of evil; and it is also said this means: He made easy for him to come out of the way of the womb,

arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ
text: (Then causeth him to die) after this, (and burieth him) and commanded to bury him;

arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُ
text: (Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life) i.e. He will resurrect him from the grave.

arabic: كَلاَّ لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُ
text: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but (man) hath not done what He commanded him) of profession of Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلإِنسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ
text: (Let man consider his food) let the disbelieving person, 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab, think about the food he eats, how it is transformed from state to state until it reaches him to eat:

arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبّاً
text: Allah then explained these different states, saying: (How We pour water) i.e. rain (in showers) upon the earth

arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلأَرْضَ شَقّاً
text: (Then split the earth in clefts) through plants

arabic: فَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبّاً
text: (And cause the grain) all kinds of grain (to grow therein) in the earth

arabic: وَعِنَباً وَقَضْباً
text: (And grapes and green fodder

arabic: وَزَيْتُوناً وَنَخْلاً
text: And olive trees and palm-trees

arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْباً
text: And garden closes of thick foliage

arabic: وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبّاً
text: And fruits) different kinds of fruit (and grasses) and fodder; and it also said this means: straw:

arabic: مَّتَاعاً لَّكُمْ وَلأَنْعَامِكُمْ
text: (Provision for you) the grains are of benefit to you (and your cattle) and fodder is of benefit to your cattle.

arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
text: (But when the Shout cometh) when the Hour comes, all created beings will scream and then submit and answer the call. Created being will be abased and know then that its advent is true.

arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
text: Allah then explained when this will happen, saying: (On the day when a man) the believer (fleeth from his brother) who is a disbeliever

arabic: وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ
text: (And his mother) and will also flee from his mother (and his father

arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ
text: And his wife and his children) it is also said this means: when Abel will flee from Cain, and Muhammad (pbuh) will flee from his mother Aminah, and Abraham from his father, and Lot from his wife Wa'ilah and Nuh from his son Canaan.

arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِىءٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
text: (Every man that day) on the Day of Judgement (will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others)) to keep him preoccupied from others.

arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
text: (On that day faces) the faces of the believers who are true in their faith (will be bright as dawn) will be blooming due to Allah's pleasure with them,

arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
text: (Laughing) pleased with Allah's bestowal of honour upon them, (rejoicing at good news) happy with Allah's reward;

arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
text: (And other faces) the faces of the hypocrites and disbelievers, (on that day) on the Day of Judgement, (with dust upon them,

arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
text: Veiled in darkness) gloomy and dark,

arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
text: (Those) with such a trait (are the disbelievers) in Allah, (the wicked) the liars against Allah'.

arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the sun is overthrown): '(When the sun is overthrown) it is also said that He says: when the sun is turned around as one turns a turban and is then thrown into the veil of light; it is also said this means: when the light of the sun vanishes.

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
text: (And when the stars fall) on the face of the earth,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
text: (And when the hills are moved) from above the surface of the earth

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
text: (And when the camels big with young are abandoned) because they are preoccupied with their own selves,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
text: (And when the wild beasts are herded together) for retaliation; and it is also said this means: when they are dead,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
text: (And when the seas rise) and mix with each other, the sweet seas and the salty seas, such that they become one sea; and it is also said this means: when they become a burning site,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
text: (And when souls are reunited) in pairs; it is also said this means: when souls are reunited with their companions: the believer with the maiden of Paradise and the disbeliever with Satan; the righteous with the righteous and the sinful with the sinful,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
text: (And when the girl child that was buried alive is asked) i.e. when she asks her father

arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ
text: (For what sin she was slain) for what sin did you kill me; it is also said that this means: when the one who killed her is asked: for what sin did you kill her,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
text: (And when the pages) the registers of good and bad deeds (are laid open) for reckoning; it is also said this means: when they fly about in people's hands,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
text: (And when the sky is torn away,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
text: And when hell is lighted) for the disbelievers

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
text: (And when the Garden is brought nigh) for the believers

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
text: ((Then) every soul will know) every soul whether it is righteous or sinful will know at that point (what it hath made ready) what it has sent forth of good or evil.

arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
text: (Oh, but I call to witness) He says: I swear by (the planets) which appear at night and disappear during the day,

arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
text: (The stars which rise and set) they move at night in the galaxy sweeping away the day and then go back to their positions and disappear; the reference here is to five planets: Venus, Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, and Mercury;

arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
text: (And the close of night,

arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
text: And the breath of morning) and when the morning and brightens come; Allah swore by all these

arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
text: (That this) i.e. the Qur'an (is in truth the word of an honoured messenger) Allah says: it is brought down by Gabriel to a messenger who is honoured by Allah, i.e. Muhammad (pbuh)

arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
text: (Mighty) against his enemies, i.e. Gabriel, (established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne) he has standing and esteem with his Lord,

arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
text: ((One) to be obeyed) i.e. Gabriel is obeyed in Heaven: the angels obey him, (and trustworthy) in conveying the message to the prophets;

arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
text: (And your comrade) your Prophet Muhammad, O Quraysh (is not mad) bewitched as you claim.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
text: (Surely he beheld him) Muhammad (s)aw Gabriel (on the clear horizon) on the high setting of the sun.

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
text: (And he is not) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (avid of the Unseen) he is accused with regard to the revelation; and it is also said this means: he is not avaricious.

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ
text: (Nor is this) i.e. the Qur'an (the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned) the utterance of an accursed, rebellious devil whose name is al-Marmi.

arabic: فَأيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
text: (Whither then go ye) from Allah's chastisement, commands and prohibitions, O disbelievers? It is also said this means: why do you lie? And it is also said this means: why do you deviate from the Qur'an and refuse to believe in it?

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
text: (This is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught else than a reminder) an admonition from Allah (unto creation) the jinn and humankind,

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
text: (Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight) to whoever wills to conform to the commands of Allah: the belief in Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
text: (And ye will not) conform with or believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (unless (it be) that Allah willeth) it for you, (the Lord of Creation) the Lord of all that which has a soul and creeps on the face of the earth, from the inhabitants of the heaven and of the earth'.

arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is cleft asunder): '(When the heaven is cleft asunder) by the descent of the Lord-a descent without modality-and the angels and whatever He wills of His command,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
text: (When the planets are dispersed) on the face of the earth,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
text: (When the seas are poured forth) into each other, the sweet into the salty, such that they become one sea,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
text: (And the sepulchres are overturned) the dead in them are taken out,

arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
text: (A soul) every soul at that point (will know what it hath sent before (it)) of good or evil (and what left behind) of good or evil wont; it is also said this means: it will know the acts of obedience it offered and those it missed.

arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
text: (O man!) i.e. O disbelieving man; here referring specifically to Kildah Ibn Usayd (What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord) when you disbelieved in Him, (the Bountiful) the Forgiving,

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
text: (Who created thee) a living being from a sperm drop, (then fashioned) in the womb of your mother, (then proportioned thee) then made your stature erect?

arabic: فِيۤ أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
text: (Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee) if He wills He makes you resemble your paternal or maternal uncles, He can make you handsome or ugly; and if He wills He can turn you into the form of an ape or swine, or the like of them.

arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
text: (Nay) truly, (but they) the Quraysh (deny the Judgement) and the Reckoning.

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
text: (Lo! there are above you guardians) among the angels who guard and preserve your works,

arabic: كِرَاماً كَاتِبِينَ
text: (Generous) who are honoured in the sight of Allah and completely surrendered to Him (and recording) they record your works,

arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
text: (Who know (all) that ye do) and say of good and evil and record all of it.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
text: (Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith: Abu Bakr and his believing brothers (verily will be in delight) in the Garden whose bliss is everlasting.

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ
text: (And lo! the wicked) Kildah and his fellow disbelievers (verily will be in hell;

arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
text: They will burn therein) they will enter the Fire (on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning and Judgement between created beings,

arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
text: (And will not) i.e. the disbelievers (be absent thence) whence they enter it.

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
text: (Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Judgement is!) what is the Day of Reckoning. (Again, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad

arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
text: (what the Day of Judgement is!) what the Day of Reckoning is. He said this to arouse his astonishment, in order to magnify such a Day.

arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئاً وَٱلأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
text: Allah the explained to him, saying: (A day on which no soul) no believing soul (hath power at all) no power to save or intercede (for any (other) soul) for any disbelieving soul. (The (absolute) command) sentencing and judging between people (on that day is Allah's) is in Allah's hands; none other than Him has that in his power and none will challenge Him about it'.

arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying: (Woe unto the defrauders): '(Woe) severe punishment (unto the defrauders) in weighing and measurement; this refers to the people of Medina who used to cheat in weighing and measurement before the coming of the Prophet (pbuh) and so this surah was revealed to the Prophet (pbuh) on his way when he was migrating to Medina:

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
text: Allah then explained who these defrauders are, saying: (Those who when they take the measure from mankind) those who, when they buy from people and weigh or measure that which they buy for themselves, (demand it full) they weigh and measure their merchandise in full,

arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
text: (But if they measure unto them) but when they measure for others (or weigh for them, they cause them loss) they decrease the measurement or the weight and behave very badly; it is also said that the above means: severe punishment on that day is unto the defrauders in the prayer, the poor-due, fasting and other acts of worship.

arabic: أَلا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوثُونَ
text: (Do such (men)) those who deal in fraud in weight and measurement (not consider) not know and believe (that they will be raised again) brought back to life

arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
text: Unto an awful Day) the Day of Judgement whose horrors are great,

arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
text: (The day when (all) mankind stand) after emerging from the graves (before the Lord of the Worlds) the Lord of every living being who walks on the earth and the Lord of the dwellers of heaven? When the Prophet (pbuh) read to them this surah, they repented and started giving full weight and measurement.

arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
text: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the vile) the works of the disbelievers (is in Sijjin

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
text: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is) what is in Sijjin! This is mentioned by way of aggrandizement of Sijjin.

arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
text: (A written record) He says: the works of the children of Adam are written on a green rock under the seventh earth; this is Sijjin.

arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) unto the deniers of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
text: (Those who deny the Day of Judgement) and the Reckoning which will take place in it

arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلاَّ كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
text: (Which none denieth) i.e. none denies the Day of Judgement (save each criminal transgressor) save each sinful and unjust person who transgresses against the Truth, such as al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi,

arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
text: (Who, when thou readest unto him) unto al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (Our revelations) the Qur'an explaining the commands and prohibitions, (saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old) this is nothing but the lies and idle talk of the people of old.

arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
text: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but that which they have earned) which they have done and said in their state of idolatry (is rust upon their hearts) Allah has sealed the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Day of Judgement; it is also said that the accumulation of sins blackens the heart and this is what is meant by the rust of hearts.

arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
text: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but surely on that day) the Day of Judgement (they) i.e. the deniers of the Day of Judgement (will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord) they will be prevented from beholding their Lord while the believers will behold Him.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُواْ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
text: (Then lo! they verily will burn in hell) then they will enter the Fire,

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
text: (And it will be said (unto them)) the keepers of hell will say to them when they enter it: (This is that which ye used to deny) this is the chastisement which you used to claim it will never happen.

arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
text: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the righteous) the works of those who are true in their faith (is in 'Illiyyin

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
text: Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what 'Illiyyin is!) what is in 'Illiyyin.

arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
text: (A written record) it is said that the works of the righteous are written on tablets made of green chrysolite which are placed above the seventh heaven below the Throne of the Beneficent; this is 'Illiyyin,

arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
text: (Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)) the works of the righteous are attested by the dwellers of heaven who are near their Lord.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
text: (Lo! the righteous) those who are true in their faith, and these are the ones who do not harm even the tiniest ant (verily are in delight) in Paradise whose bliss is everlasting,

arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
text: (On couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the inhabitants of the Fire,

arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
text: (Thou wilt know) O Muhammad (in their faces) the faces of the inhabitants of Paradise (the radiance of delight

arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
text: They are given to drink) in Paradise (of a pure wine, sealed) mixed,

arabic: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذَلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
text: (Whose seal) whose end result (is musk. For this) for what I have mentioned (let (all) those who strive for bliss) let those who work and those who strive and those who hasten and those who take the initiative take the initiative.

arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
text: (And mixed with water of Tasnim,

arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
text: A spring) gushing forth for them from the Garden of Eden (whence those brought near to Allah drink) those who are near to the Garden of Eden drink from the spring of Tasnim.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ يَضْحَكُونَ
text: (Lo! the guilty) the idolaters, Abu Jahl and his host (used to laugh at those who believed) used to mock and poke fun at 'Ali and his fellow believers,

arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
text: (And wink one to another) they slander the believers (when they passed them) when the believers passed the disbelievers in their way to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh);

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
text: (And when they) the disbelievers (returned to their own folk, they returned jesting) they returned happy with their idolatry and mocking the believers;

arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ لَضَالُّونَ
text: (And when they saw them) and when they saw the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (they said) i.e. the disbelievers said: (Lo! These) the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (have gone astray) from true guidance.

arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
text: (Yet they were not sent) they were not set upon the believers (as guardians over them) as guardians over them or over their works.

arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
text: (This day) which is the Day of Judgement (it is those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an: i.e. 'Ali and his fellow believers (who have the laugh of disbelievers) who will laugh at the disbelievers,

arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
text: (On high couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the people of the Fire being dragged therein.

arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفْعَلُونَ
text: (Are not the disbelievers paid) rewarded in the Hereafter (for what they used to do) except for what they used to do and say in the life of the world?'

arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is split asunder): '(When the heaven is split asunder) by the clouds because of the descent of the Lord-a descent without any modality-and the angels and whatever Allah wills of His command.

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
text: (And attentive) and it obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear) and it befits her to do so,

arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
text: (And when the earth is spread out) like the spreading out of a flat plain; and it is also said this means: when the earth is removed from its place and then flattened.

arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
text: (And hath cast out all that was in her) of corpses and treasures, (and is empty) from all of that

arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
text: (And attentive) and obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear!) and it behoves her do so.

arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحاً فَمُلاَقِيهِ
text: (Thou, verily, O man) O disbelieving man, in reference to Abu'l-Aswad Ibn Kildah Ibn Usayd Ibn Khalaf, (art working) He says: you are working something in your state of disbelief and shall return with it (towards thy Lord) in the Hereafter (a work which you will meet (in His presence)) whether your work is righteous or evil.

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَـٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
text: (Then whoso is given his account) the account of his good works (in his right hand) in reference here to Abu Salamah Ibn 'Abd al-Asad

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَاباً يَسِيراً
text: (He truly will receive an easy reckoning) this refers to his parade before Allah

arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
text: (And will return) in the Hereafter (unto his folk) whom Allah prepared for him in Paradise (in joy) with them.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِ
text: (But whoso is given his account) the account of his evil deeds (behind his back) in his left hand, referring here to al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd al-Asad, the brother of Abu Salamah,

arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُواْ ثُبُوراً
text: (He surely will invoke destruction

arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيراً
text: And be thrown to scorching fire.

arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِيۤ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
text: He verily lived joyous with his folk) he was happy with his folk,

arabic: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
text: (He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)) in the Hereafter.

arabic: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيراً
text: (Nay, but lo! his Lord) when He created him (is ever looking on him!) knew that He will raise him again after death

arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
text: (Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
text: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth) and I swear by the night and that which returns to its place when the night falls,

arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
text: (And by the moon when she is at the full) for three nights: the nights of the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth of the lunar month

arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقاً عَن طَبقٍ
text: (That ye shall journey) the whole creation shall be transformed (on from plane to plane) from one state to another; from the time He created them until the time they die, and from the time they die until they enter either Paradise or hell: in all these times Allah transforms them from one state to another; it is also said that this means: you shall journey, O Muhammad, from one heaven to another on the day of the ascent; and it is also said that this means: this denier will go from one state to another, from the time he dies until he enters the Fire.

arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ
text: (What aileth them) the disbelievers of Mecca; and it is said this refers to the three sons of 'Abd Yalayl al-Thaqafi: Mas'ud, Habib and Rabi'ah, the last two had later on accepted Islam (then, that they believe not) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِىءَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْآنُ لاَ يَسْجُدُونَ
text: (And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them) and when Muhammad (pbuh) recites the Qur'an to them explaining the commands and prohibitions, (worship not (Allah)) do not submit to Allah by believing in Allah's divine Oneness?

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
text: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca and those among the sons of 'Abd Yalayl who did not believe (will deny) will disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an;

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
text: (And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding) and Allah knows best what they say and do; and it is also said this means: Allah knows best what they hear and hide in their hearts.

arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
text: (So give them) so give, O Muhammad, to those who disbelieve in Allah (tidings of a painful doom) whose pain will extend to their hearts on the Day of Badr as well as in the Hereafter,

arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
text: Allah then exempted from these the believers, saying: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and do good works) and do acts of obedience privately between themselves and their Lord, (for theirs is a reward) in Paradise (unfailing) undiminished and unblemished; it is also said this means: they will not be constantly reminded about the blessings bestowed upon them; and it is also said this means: their good deeds will not be decreased after they reach old age or after they die'.

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars): '(By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars) He says: Allah swears by the heaven which includes mansions of the stars; it is also said: He swears by the heaven which has mansions between heaven and earth; Allah knows that,

arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
text: (And by the Promised Day) which is the Day of Judgement.

arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
text: (And by the witness) the day of Friday (and that whereunto he beareth testimony) the day of 'Arafah and it is said it is the day of immolation; it is also said that 'the witness' refers to the children of Adam while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' refers to the Day of Judgement; and it is also said that 'the witness' is Muhammad (pbuh) while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' is his community; Allah swore by all these things that His chastisement of those who disbelieve in Him is very severe,

arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلأُخْدُودِ
text: ((Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
text: Of the fuel-fed fire) slandered were the owners of the ditch; it is also said that they were believers who were killed by the disbelievers by means of fire in which they threw naphtha, oil and firewood,

arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
text: (When they) i.e. the disbelievers (sat by it) by the ditch; and it is said: they sat on chairs when Allah burned them with the Fire,

arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
text: (And were themselves the witnesses) they used to testify that the believers were folk of error (of what they did to the believers) and it is said this means: they were present when they did this to the believers.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَن يُؤْمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
text: (They had naught against them) against the believers nor did they find any fault with them (save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty) in His retribution against those who disbelieve in Him, (the Owner of Praise) for those who believe in Him,

arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
text: (Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty) the stores (of the heavens) rain (and the earth) plants; (and Allah is of all things the Witness) He is the Witness over their works.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
text: (Lo! they who persecute) those who burn and torture with fire (believing men) men who are true in their faith (and believing women) who are true in their faith (and repent not) from their idolatry and disbelief, (theirs verily will be the doom of hell) in the Hereafter, (and theirs the doom of burning) in the Fire; and it is also said: in the life of the world, for Allah had burned them with the Fire. These were people from Najran, and it is said from Mosul, who tortured and consequently killed a group of believers with fire in attempt to make them renounce their religion. The name of the king of these people is Yusuf, and it is said his name is Dhu'l-Nuwas.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلأَنْهَارُ ذَلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
text: Allah then mentioned the believers who did not renounce their religion despite being tortured, saying: (Lo! those who believe) in Allah (and do good works) privately between themselves and their Lord, (theirs will be Gardens beneath which) beneath its trees and habitations (rivers flow) rivers of wine, water, honey and milk flow. (That is the Great Success) they earned the Garden and were saved from the Fire.

arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
text: (Lo! the punishment of thy Lord) the seizure of your Lord of those who disbelieve in Him (is stern.

arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِىءُ وَيُعِيدُ
text: Lo! He it is Who produceth) He it is Who begins creation from a sperm drop, (then reproduceth) a new creation after death,

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
text: (And He is the Forgiving) He forgives he who repents of disbelief and believes in Allah, (the Loving) He loves His friends; and it is also said this means: He loves those who obey Him,

arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
text: (Lord of the Throne of Glory) the good and fine Throne; and it is also said this means: Lord of the glorious Throne,

arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
text: (Doer of what He will) as He wills, He gives life and also takes it away.

arabic: هَلُ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
text: (Hath there come unto thee) O Muhammad-He asked His Prophet about this because He did not inform him about it before and then He did-(the story of the hosts

arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
text: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud) and of those before and after them, what We did to them when they disbelieved?

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكْذِيبٍ
text: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca (live in denial) of Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِمْ مُّحِيطٌ
text: (And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them) He says: He is Aware of them and of their works.

arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ
text: (Nay, but it) i.e. the Qur'an which Muhammad (pbuh) recites to you (is a glorious Qur'an) is a noble and honoured Qur'an

arabic: فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ
text: (On a guarded tablet) He says: it is written on a tablet that is protected from the devils'.

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the heaven and the Morning Star): '(By the heaven and the Morning Star) He says: Allah swears by the heaven and the morning star

arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
text: (Ah, what will tell thee) O Muhammad (what the Morning Star is!) this is to arouse his astonishment.

arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
text: Allah then explained by saying: (The piercing Star!) the bright, piercing star; this refers to the planet Saturn which shines at night and disappears during the day.

arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
text: (No human soul) no believing or disbelieving soul-this is why Allah swore-(but hath a guardian over it) who record its words and deeds until he drives it into the grave.

arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلإِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
text: (So let man) Abu Talib (consider from what he is created) from what his soul is created.

arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
text: Allah then explained, saying: (He is created from a gushing fluid) into the womb of a woman

arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
text: (That issued from between the loins) of a man (and ribs) the ribs of a woman.

arabic: إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ
text: (Lo! He) i.e. Allah (verily is Able to return him (unto life)) He is able to return that fluid from whence it came and He is Able to bring him back after death and revive him.

arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَىٰ ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
text: (On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out) when all the secrets that a person knows, and no one else other than him knows, become manifest.

arabic: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلاَ نَاصِرٍ
text: (Then will he) Abu Talib (have no might) to defend himself (nor any helper) to shield him from Allah's chastisement.

arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
text: (By the heaven which giveth the returning rain) Allah swore by the heaven which accumulates clouds after cloud, year after year,

arabic: وَٱلأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
text: (And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)) and it is also said this means: and by the earth which has firm pillars

arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
text: This is the reason why Allah swore: (Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word) a true exposition; it is also said this means: it is a judgement from Allah,

arabic: وَمَا هوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
text: (It is no pleasantry) it is no falsehood.

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْداً
text: (Lo! They) i.e. the people of Mecca (plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)) they scheme in their state of disbelief, that is to say they bar people from Muhammad (pbuh) and from the Qur'an; it is also said this means: they plan, in Dar al-Nadwah, to kill you, O Muhammad!

arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْداً
text: (And I plot a plot (against them)) and I want to kill them, O Muhammad, on the Day of Badr.

arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْداً
text: (So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while) give them a while until the Day of Badr'.

arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
text: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High): '(Praise the name of your Lord the Most High) He says: pray, O Muhammad, by the command of your Lord the Most High, Who is Higher than all things; it is also said that this means: remember, O Muhammad, the divine Oneness of your Lord; and it is said this means: say, O Muhammad, in your prostration “praise be to my Lord the Most High”,

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
text: (Who createth) every thing that has a soul, (then disposeth) He created them with two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears and with other organs too;

arabic: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
